faq.q: What is the lucky number for Chitraksha?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Chitraksha is 8 (ruling planet Saturn). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Chitraksha?
faq.a: Saturday is the traditional association for Chitraksha. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Chitraksha?
faq.a: Blue Sapphire is the traditional association for Chitraksha. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Chitraksha?
faq.a: Blue, Black are the traditional associations for Chitraksha. These are interpretive.
